newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kellogg EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kellogg EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs analyst Nomi Ghez on Thursday said she cut her 1996 earnings estimate by by $0.10 a share to $3.15.
-- The 1997 earnings estimate by $0.10 to $3.65 a share, which Ghez said could prove optimistic unless the domestic cereal market resumes growth.

-- This followed an announcement by Kellogg on September 4 that its third quarter results will be about 20 percent below the $1.05 a share it earned a year ago and that full-year 1996 earnings will be less than the $3.48 it earned in 1995.

-- "The company as expected blamed the shortfalls on competitive promotion activity in the domestic cereal market, which is likely to result in eight to 10 percent domestic volume decline for Kellogg in the quarter," Ghez said in a report.
-- Ghez added that Kellogg may reaccelerate its promotional spending or resort to another price cut if its competitors do not scale back on their promotional spending.
-- Ghez said she rates Kellogg and its rival, General Mills Inc, market performers.
-- Kellogg shares in composite trading rose 1-7/8 at 67-1/8, but declined 1-3/8 at 67-1/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
